# JSXGraph

Self-hosted browser distribution, pinned to **1.13.3**. No Node or build tooling is required.

Upstream: https://jsxgraph.org/ and https://github.com/jsxgraph/jsxgraph

Downloaded unchanged from:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsxgraph@1.13.3/distrib/jsxgraphcore.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsxgraph@1.13.3/distrib/jsxgraph.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsxgraph@1.13.3/LICENSE.MIT

Used under the MIT license; see `1.13.3/LICENSE.MIT`. The distribution retains its upstream notices.

To upgrade, download a new version into a sibling version directory and update the paths in `templates/page.html`. Check the interactive diagram and its static fallback before publishing.
